_about: Hellhound Derby guest racers, written by art/derby/scripts/export_assets.py from art/derby/guests.json and out/guests. Your own go in config/games_derby_guests/ (the same format).

guests.name: Hamageddon
guests.bio: Seven feet of angry pork. Nobody invited him.

hello: Seven feet of pork. Zero fucks.
I'm here to win. Then I eat the losers.
Oink. That means you're all gonna die.
Nobody invited me. I came anyway.
ticker: {a} IS IN THE GATE. NOBODY WANTS THE LANE NEXT TO HIM.
{a} IS HERE. THE CATERING VAN HAS LOCKED ITSELF.
by: I've eaten bigger dogs than you, {t}!
This little piggy went past YOU, {t}!
Make way for the main course!
Run, {t}! Run while you still have legs!
at: You smell like a burnt barbecue, {t}!
What the fuck even ARE you, {t}?!
Somebody get the apple for his mouth!
Run, {t}, run! Straight to the butcher!
back: Keep running, {t}. I like my meat tender.
I can smell your fear, {t}. It smells delicious.
ouch: NOT THE HAM! NOT THE HAM!
WHO THREW THAT?! I'LL EAT THEM!
lose: I wasn't hungry anyway!
This race was rigged by vegetarians!
Last? I'll eat the scoreboard!
Squeal of shame...
say: Pigs can't sweat. That's why I'm this fucking angry.
Ninety percent pork. Ten percent hate. All muscle.
Know what pigs do with a body? Ask the last guy. You can't.
Crawled out of the slop pits of the Fifth Circle. Barefoot.
Truffle pig? I sniff out losers. Found one, {t}.
Put an apple in my mouth and lose your fucking arm.
When pigs fly? Look up, {t}. I'm jumping.
This little piggy went to market. Then he ATE the market.
Rolled in shit all morning. Race prep.
Snout, trotters, tusks. Pick what kills you, {t}.
I'm not fat. I'm seven feet of marbled rage.
My mother was a sow. My father was a war crime.
Ham. HAM. Say it with fear.
Three little pigs? I ate the wolf. Then the other two.
Hog wild? This is me CALM.
I don't race. I stampede in one direction.
Smell my breath, {t}. That's your cousin.
Oink is short for 'I will eat your face'.
env: Hell smells like a barbecue. I'm a little fucking worried.
Nice mud. Shame it's on fire.
Lava? That's my hot tub. Bring snacks.
A geyser just went up my ass. I'm smoked Ham now.
Crowd threw a toilet. I drank from it. Don't judge me.
Three tiers of screaming meat. Big buffet. Bigger appetite.
Sulfur stink? Smells like my trough. Homey.
Mug of blood to the face. Thanks. Gravy.

mootilator: Pork beats beef, Moo. Ask any butcher.
Moo, you've been lost in a maze for years. I'd have eaten the walls.
cockfather: Cocky, I eat roosters like you for breakfast. With eggs. Your eggs.
Your barnyard mob doesn't scare me, Cocky. I AM the barnyard.
swampass: Swampy, I rolled in your swamp. Smells like your ass. Five stars.
lordhorny: Horny, you're lord of Hell? I'm lord of lunch. Bow.
bubba: Bubba, we both stop for snacks. Only one of us eats the other.

guests.name: Skullduggery
guests.bio: All bone, no brain. Lighter than everyone and twice as smug.

hello: I've got a bone to pick with all of you.
No skin, no organs, no fucks given.
Ran here from the graveyard. Didn't even break a sweat. Can't sweat.
Rattle rattle, bitches.
ticker: {a} HAS NO SKIN IN THE GAME. LITERALLY.
{a} IS IN THE GATE. HE HAS ALREADY LOST TWO TOES.
THE HOUNDS HAVE NOTICED {a}. THEY ARE DROOLING.
by: Eat my dust, {t}! I used to be someone!
I've got a bone to pick with you, {t}!
Feel that breeze, {t}? That's my ribcage.
Too slow, {t}! Even my marrow's faster!
Spineless? I've got the whole spine, {t}!
at: Mine! MINE! THE BONES ARE MINE!
I'm gonna bury you in the yard, {t}!
Drink some milk, {t}, you look brittle!
You're all bones, {t}! I'll gnaw you later!
back: Keep your slobber off my femur, {t}!
Joke's on you, {t}. I'm already dead.
ouch: I FELT THAT IN MY MARROW!
OW! Wait. I don't have nerves. Still OW!
dodge: Missed! Nothing in here but air!
win: Victory! I'd cry, but no eyes.
Back from the dead and straight to the top!
lose: I'm dying out here. Again.
Worked myself to the bone for this?!
Bury me. Seriously, put me back.
My heart wasn't in it. I don't have one.
say: Two hundred and six bones. Every one of them smug.
I've got a boner. Two hundred and six of them, actually.
Can't eat, can't drink, can't fuck. CAN pass you, {t}.
Doot doot! Calcium's on me.
No brain, no fear. Also no clue where the finish is.
Dug myself out of a graveyard for this. Six feet of dirt, zero sweat.
Cremation's my only weakness. Keep the lighters away.
Dead three hundred years. Still faster than your ass, {t}.
I'd flip you off, {t}, but that finger fell off a lap ago.
Skeleton crew? I AM the crew.
Skin's a costume. I took mine off. Freedom.
No body. Nobody. Get it? I'm hilarious.
Bone dry, bone idle, bone fast.
Rattling past, {t}! That's the sound of winning!
Lighter than you, {t}. No guts, no gravy.
The wind goes right through my ribs. Aerodynamic as fuck.
Got a skeleton in my closet. It's me. I live there.
I'm what you'll look like after this race, {t}.
env: Lava can't cook me. No meat. Suck it, Hell.
Heat? I'm already bone dry. Bring it.
The crowd's throwing bones. Free spare parts!
A skull just flew past. Hey, cousin!
Zombies in the stands. Amateurs. They still have skin on.
Sulfur stink? No nose. Best day of my afterlife.
Smoke goes straight through my ribs. I'm a chimney.
Racing with hellhounds. I'm basically a walking dog treat.
Flame geyser right up the pelvis. Tickles.

harry: Harry, you're all bones too. Stop staring at mine.
Eat me, Hungry Harry, and you'll choke on a femur.
michaelmild: Mild Mike, you can't stab me. Nothing in here to stab.
Michael Mild never runs. Skully never stops. Bye.
fazbutt: Fazbutt, there's a skeleton in your suit. Let him out, he's family.
Five nights? Fazbutt, I've been dead five hundred.
mange: Mange, keep your fleas. I've got no skin for them to bite.

guests.name: The Cockfather
guests.bio: A ripped rooster with an axe. Runs the coop. Runs the track.

hello: I'm gonna make you an offer you can't refuse. Run.
Big cock energy has entered the track.
Look at these arms. Now look at your nuggets.
Some call me a chicken. They don't call anymore.
ticker: {a} HAS BROUGHT AN AXE. NOBODY ASKED WHY.
{a} IS DOING PUSH-UPS IN THE GATE. HIS LANE IS FULL OF FEATHERS.
{a} SAYS THE FIRST HOUND TO CLUCK AT HIM GETS PLUCKED.
by: Leave the gun. Take the drumstick.
I've laid bigger eggs than you, {t}!
at: Why'd the chicken cross the track, {t}? To LOSE!
back: You come to me on the day of my race and you PASS me, {t}?!
Keep your friends close, {t}. Keep your nuggets closer.
ouch: BAWK! BAWWWK! SON OF A BITCH!
WHO DID THAT?! YOU SLEEP WITH THE FISHES!
NOT THE COMB! NOT THE COMB!
dodge: Too slow! I've got chicken reflexes!
Nice try. The family will remember this.
win: The Cockfather always wins. Kiss the claw.
Winner winner, I AM the chicken dinner!
lose: This isn't over. The family will hear of this.
I got plucked... I got PLUCKED!
Somebody's getting fried for this.
Bawk... bawk...
say: In this coop we got rules. Rule one: I'm the cock.
I didn't come to Hell to race. I came to collect.
Kiss the ring, {t}. It's on my claw. Pucker up.
The axe? It's for business. Mostly.
You come to my track, you lay an egg for the family.
Up at four, thousand push-ups, crow. Then I break legs.
Every hen in the coop pays protection. Every dog pays double.
Nobody calls me chicken. The last guy's a sandwich now.
I'm gonna make you a bucket you can't refuse, {t}.
Cock-a-doodle-don't fuck with me.
Some birds fly south. Some birds go missing. I handle both.
My bicep's bigger than your whole future, {t}.
Feathers? Pecks? I got ABS, motherfucker.
It's not a crow. It's a warning.
I'm a businessman. My business is plucking.
Talk to the family, {t}. The family's a deep fryer.
Someday I'll ask you a favour. The favour is losing.
Just when I thought I was out, they pull me back into the coop.
env: Lava, fire, screaming. Reminds me of Sunday dinner with the family.
Hell's my kind of town. Everybody here owes somebody.
Throw another toilet, pal. I'll remember your face.
That demon threw a war hammer at me. Nice arm. He works for me now.
Sulfur and burnt feathers. Smells like a hit gone right.
Three tiers of monsters, and not one of 'em paid me for the seat.
These flame geysers? I want a piece of every one.
Smile for the photo-finish, boys. It's evidence.
Twitch chat, put your coins on the cock. Smart money.

honkhogan: Hogan, you honk in my coop again, you're foie gras.
Hogan, I don't wrestle. I make problems disappear.
petergriffint: Peter. You beat up my cousin for twenty years. Today we settle it.
Peter, the chicken sends his regards. I AM the regards.
hamageddon: Ham, the farm's got a pecking order. You're breakfast.
mootilator: Moo, I run the barn. You can't even find the exit.
gnash: Gnash, you slime my track again, I pull those teeth one by one.

guests.name: Totally A Barrel
guests.bio: Definitely a barrel. Ignore the legs. And the teeth.

hello: I am a barrel. Barrels don't race. Please ignore me.
Totally normal barrel. Nothing to see. Come closer.
Hello. I contain beer. Come and look. Closer.
I'm not a monster. I'm a barrel. With teeth.
ticker: {a} IS DEFINITELY JUST A BARREL. IT HAS ALREADY EATEN A STEWARD.
{a} WAS ON THE JUNK CART. NOW IT IS IN THE GATE.
OFFICIALS CONFIRM {a} IS A BARREL. THE OFFICIALS ARE MISSING.
by: Barrel coming through! Totally normal barrel!
Want a drink, {t}? Come closer. Closer.
at: Somebody throw it back in the stands!
I'll piss on you like any other barrel, {t}!
What's in the barrel, {t}?! Don't answer!
Who keeps throwing junk on the track?!
ouch: WHO THROWS JUNK AT A BARREL?!
dodge: Ha! Harder to hit lying down.
win: A barrel won. Nobody check the barrel.
Barrel of fun! BARREL OF FUN!
lose: Just a barrel. Barrels don't win.
Back to the junk pile...
I'll be in the stands. Waiting to be thrown.
say: Just a barrel. Waiting by the track. Like barrels do.
Those aren't legs. They're... staves. Long, running staves.
That's not a tongue. That's the tap. Have a sip, {t}.
Full of loot. Reach in. Elbow deep. Go on.
Mimic? Never heard of it. I'm oak.
Do a barrel roll! ...No. I do the rolling. You do the screaming.
Aged twelve years in oak. The oak is me. So are the adventurers.
A big ape used to throw my cousins at a plumber. I ate the ape.
Inside me: beer, gold, three adventurers. Mostly legs.
Video game rule: smash every barrel. Please don't.
I'm not chasing you, {t}. I'm rolling downhill. Toward you.
Barrels don't shit. Ignore the trail.
Dungeon born, dungeon fed. Somebody opened me once. Once.
Hoops. Staves. Teeth. Standard barrel stuff.
Barrel of laughs. Barrel of monkeys. Barrel of YOU, soon.
Booze barrel by day. Body barrel by night.
*creaks innocently*
Splinters in the throat, {t}. That's how barrels say hello.
env: Hot as fuck. My wood's sweating sap. Normal barrel behaviour.
Lava next to a wooden barrel. Who planned this? Asking for me.
The crowd's throwing barrels. My family. MY FAMILY.
Red drums in the stands. Cheap metal posers.
Flame geyser. Great. I'm kindling with teeth.
They throw toilets too. At least nobody's using me as one.
Photo-finish camera. Smile? Barrels don't smile. *grins with eighty teeth*
Junk flying from every tier. Nobody suspects the barrel.

sussybaka: Only room for one impostor here, Sussy. And I'm a barrel.
Nobody's sus here, Sussy. Least of all the barrel with teeth.
suckby: Don't inhale me, Suckby. Barrels bite on the way down.
hamageddon: Ham, they pickle pork in barrels. Just saying. Climb in.
Hey, Hamageddon. The brine's inside. Come closer.
bubba: Bubba, want a snack? Snacks are inside the barrel. Reach in.
You stop for snacks, Bubba. I stop for Bubba.

guests.name: Moo-tilator
guests.bio: Half bull, all berserker. Escaped a maze. Never found the exit.

hello: I don't run in circles. I run THROUGH things.
Moo. That's bull for 'you're dead'.
Escaped the maze. Ate the hero. Here for the trophy.
Wave a red flag. I dare you.
ticker: {a} HAS ALREADY GORED THE STARTER. THE BACKUP STARTER IS NERVOUS.
{a} IS SNORTING AT THE GATE. THE GATE IS DENTED.
{a} SAYS HE IS HERE FOR THE TROPHY. HE MEANS TO EAT IT.
by: This is no bull, {t}! You're LAST!
Bull in a china shop, {t}! You're the china!
I'll turn you into a rug, {t}!
at: I'm gonna eat you with fries, {t}!
back: Oh, you're gonna get the HORNS, {t}!
YOU'RE SEEING RED? I'M SEEING RED!
ouch: MY HORN! YOU CHIPPED MY HORN!
WHO THREW THAT?! I'LL GORE YOU!
lose: This race is BULLSHIT!
I got lost. It's a maze in here.
Somebody waved a red flag at the wrong time.
I'll be in the barn. Crying.
say: This track goes in circles. Finally, a maze I can handle.
Escaped the labyrinth. Still looking for the exit. Is it you, {t}?
Double-headed axe. Single-minded bull.
The hero brought a ball of string. I flossed with it.
My mom was a queen. My dad was a bull. Don't ask how.
Pamplona was practice. You're the main event, {t}.
Every rodeo clown I've met is dead. Some of them are in the stands.
Bull market! Your stock's crashing, {t}!
Take the bull by the horns. Go on. Try it, {t}.
I'm not lost. I'm exploring aggressively.
Left, left, left, left. That's a circle? Shit.
I don't chew cud. I chew racers.
Half man, half bull, all bullshit.
Grass-fed? No. Racer-fed.
Horns, hooves, and zero sense of direction.
Every maze in Greece has my horn marks on the walls.
Matadors wave capes. I wave their legs.
Running of the bulls? It's running FROM the bull, {t}.
env: Red sky. RED SKY. I can't calm down. I'm never calming down.
Hell's a maze too. Where's the fucking exit?
Lava, black mountains, screaming. Still better signs than the labyrinth.
Someone threw a war hammer. Keeping it. Two weapons, zero exits.
Red drums flying out of the stands. They're begging for it.
Smells like a branding iron out here. Brings back memories.
Flame geyser in the face. Now I'm barbecue. Angry barbecue.
Three tiers of screaming monsters. Feels like the arena. Feels like home.

hamageddon: Beef beats pork, Ham. Ask any grill.
Seven feet, Hamageddon? I'm seven feet of pissed. With an axe.
cockfather: You run the barnyard, Cocky? I run THROUGH it.
Crow all you want, Cocky. I gored the last mob boss.
neighsayer: Cheer up, Neighsy! ...No? Fine. I'll gore some joy into you.
terry: Three heads, Terry? One of mine's enough. And it's pissed.
My maze had a guard dog too, Terry. Had.

guests.name: Lord Horny
guests.bio: A lord of Hell with enormous horns. He would like you to stop staring.

hello: Bow before your lord. Then get out of my lane.
Yes, the horns are real. Yes, everyone asks.
Escaped the ninth circle for this? Fine. I'll win it.
I am Lord Horny. Don't make it weird.
ticker: {a} HAS ARRIVED. THE FRONT ROW FEELS STRANGE.
{a} HAS ASKED THE HOUNDS TO KNEEL. THEY LICKED HIM INSTEAD.
{a} IS IN THE GATE. HIS HORNS ARE IN THE NEXT ONE.
by: I've seen faster souls in purgatory, {t}!
Hell yeah! I mean that literally.
Down, {t}! Down to the ninth circle!
at: Horny on the track! HORNY ON THE TRACK!
back: I'll drag your soul down with me, {t}!
Mock me again and I'll curse your fleas, {t}!
ouch: WHO THREW THAT?! ETERNAL TORMENT FOR YOU!
THAT'S GONNA LEAVE A MARK ON MY SOUL!
win: Hell is mine! The trophy is mine! Your souls are mine!
I came first. Don't make it weird.
lose: I've been to hell. This is worse.
The horns were slowing me down.
Curse you all! ...Eternally!
I demand a recount. In blood.
say: Eyes up here, {t}! No, higher! The HORNS!
They're not compensating for anything! They're just BIG!
My throne is made of the damned! It's lumpy! Still mine!
My horns need their own seat! They have their own fan club too!
Mind the horns! I've gored three angels and a parking attendant!
I sharpen these horns daily! Takes three demons and a belt sander!
Hell's nobility! I have a family crest! It's just horns!
I've been horny for six thousand years! It's a curse!
Kiss my ring, {t}! It's gold, it's cursed, it's on my finger!
Lords don't run! We proceed menacingly!
These horns have impaled saints! And one doorframe!
Yes, I'm horny! It's a TITLE! It's on my business cards!
Behold! Twelve feet of horn! On my HEAD, you filthy animal!
I rule a circle of Hell, {t}! You rule a dog bowl!
Every doorway in Hell is huge. My horns still get stuck.
Lord of the Second Circle! Lust! It's mostly paperwork!
Hands off the horns, {t}! They're dry-clean only!
My mother had horns. My father had horns. Hugs were dangerous.
Every demon bows to me! Mostly to duck the horns!
env: My track! My lava! My sky! You're all guests in MY Hell!
The ninth circle is frozen solid! This? This is a spa day!
Peasants! Throw your skulls at the hounds, not your LORD!
I had those flame geysers installed! Tax-deductible!
I can see my castle from here! Third black mountain on the left!
A toilet?! Which tier threw that?! I'll damn the whole row!
Sulfur in the morning! Smells like victory and farts!
Mortals betting coins in Twitch chat! Gambling! Delightful sin!
Photo-finish camera! Get my good side! BOTH horns in frame!

impotent: Imp-otent! You're fired! Again! Fetch my horn wax!
Imp-otent, your fireball wouldn't warm my bathwater!
pyramidscheme: Pyramid Scheme? Please. I run the original pyramid scheme. It's called Hell!
Your hat's pointy, Pyramid. My horns are pointier. Bow.
hamageddon: Ham! Seven feet of pork and still shorter than my horns!
ember: Ember! Elegant, on fire, and NOT staring at my horns! I like you!
